# Course Reflection: What I Learned Each Week

## Week 1: Predictive Modeling & Processes
- I learned the overall data science process, including how to load and export data in R and how R Markdown helps organize and document analysis.
- I learned the basics of predictive modeling, how to evaluate models, and how the bias-variance tradeoff impacts model performance.

## Week 2: Data Exploration
- I learned how to use summary statistics and visualizations to explore and better understand a dataset.
- I learned how to handle missing values and apply data transformations to prepare data for modeling.

## Week 3: Linear Regression
- I learned how linear regression works and how to apply it to real-world problems.
- I learned about the key assumptions of linear regression and why checking those assumptions is important for accurate results.

## Week 4: Classification
- I learned the difference between regression and classification and how logistic regression is used for classification problems.
- I learned how to evaluate classification models using performance measures like precision and recall.

## Week 5: Generalized Linear Models (GLMs)
- I learned how generalized linear models extend linear regression to handle different types of response variables.
- I learned how Poisson regression and Gamma regression are used for count data and continuous positive data.

## Week 6: Tree-Based Models
- I learned how decision trees work and how they can be used for both regression and classification tasks.
- I learned how ensemble methods like random forests and gradient boosting improve model accuracy.

## Week 7: Unsupervised Methods
- I learned how k-means clustering groups similar data points together without a labeled outcome.
- I learned how cluster analysis can be applied to real datasets, such as customer or credit card data.

## Week 8: Delivering Results
- I learned the importance of clear documentation and effective presentations when sharing results.
- I learned how to use Git and GitHub to manage versions of my work and share projects professionally.
